_help: Style presets for the Generate screen. Each style has a sentence per model: Klein gets plain prose, Qwen gets a 'Style:' description. The sentence is appended after your prompt. Edit freely; the app reloads this file on every visit. See docs/PROMPT_AUDIT.md (P2).

styles.label: Photographic
styles.klein: Shot as a natural-light photograph on a 35 mm lens, with shallow depth of field, true-to-life colour and fine film grain.
styles.qwen: Style: realistic photography with natural light, a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field, true-to-life colour and subtle film grain. Ultra HD, 4K, cinematic composition.

styles.label: Concept art
styles.klein: Rendered as painterly digital concept art with a strong, readable silhouette, atmospheric perspective and dramatic directional lighting. A clean, unbranded single illustration.
styles.qwen: Style: painterly digital concept art for film production design - strong silhouette, atmospheric perspective, dramatic directional lighting, visible brushwork, a clean unbranded single illustration. Ultra HD, 4K, cinematic composition.

styles.label: Product shot
styles.klein: Styled as a clean commercial product photograph with soft, even studio light, a seamless light backdrop, crisp controlled reflections and a centred composition.
styles.qwen: Style: clean commercial product photography - seamless light-grey backdrop, soft even studio light, crisp controlled reflections, centred composition, catalogue sharpness. Ultra HD, 4K.

styles.label: Ink sketch
styles.klein: Drawn as a black ink sketch on white paper with confident linework, cross-hatched shading and loose gestural strokes, entirely monochrome.
styles.qwen: Style: monochrome black ink sketch on white paper - confident linework, cross-hatched shading, loose gestural strokes, visible paper texture.

styles.label: Screen print
styles.klein: Printed as a screen print in two or three flat spot colours, with visible halftone dots, slight misregistration and bold graphic shapes on textured paper.
styles.qwen: Style: screen-printed poster - two to three flat spot colours, visible halftone dots, slight colour misregistration, bold graphic shapes, textured uncoated paper.

styles.label: Apparel flat
styles.klein: Presented as an apparel product image: the garment shown flat or on an invisible mannequin, front view, seamless light-grey backdrop, soft even studio light, true fabric texture and colour.
styles.qwen: Style: apparel product photography - garment flat or on an invisible mannequin, front view, seamless light-grey backdrop, soft even studio light, true fabric texture and colour.

styles.label: Footwear studio
styles.klein: Presented as a footwear product render: the shoe in lateral side view on a seamless white background with a soft contact shadow, crisp materials and clean studio light.
styles.qwen: Style: footwear product render - lateral side view, seamless white background, soft contact shadow, crisp material detail, clean studio light.

styles.label: Game concept
styles.klein: Painted as game concept art: stylised realism with painterly detail, a clear readable silhouette, a limited palette and atmospheric depth. A clean, unbranded single illustration.
styles.qwen: Style: game concept art - stylised realism, painterly detail, clear readable silhouette, limited palette, atmospheric depth. Clean, unbranded single illustration.

styles.label: Film still
styles.klein: Framed as a cinematic film still: anamorphic widescreen, motivated light with deep shadows, a muted colour grade and fine film grain.
styles.qwen: Style: cinematic film still - anamorphic widescreen framing, motivated lighting, deep shadows, muted colour grade, fine film grain.

styles.label: Car studio
styles.klein: Presented as an automotive studio photograph: the car on a seamless white-to-grey cyclorama, long softbox reflections running cleanly along the body, a soft floor reflection.
styles.qwen: Style: automotive studio photography - seamless white-to-grey cyclorama, long softbox reflections along the body, soft floor reflection.
